title: current_claims_requiring_verification
evidence_scope: QA run 54451 (permission posture, headless only) and QA run 58580 artifacts 44350, 44356, 44368 (one macOS 12 host; Codex and Cursor started after the Claude install had written machine hooks; the same run found session-harness-unattended-posture passing while interactive Codex and Cursor still prompted for yoke).
claim: Still unverified: Codex/Cursor mid-session pickup from a session with no Yoke hooks at start, and real user/project hook merge/dedup. Permission modes and curl-pipe allowance were settled by QA run 54451 (headless yoke allowed, unapproved curl refused in each restrictive default mode).
